# Grammarly

> Grammarly is an AI-powered writing assistant that helps users improve their writing across devices, languages, and professional contexts with real-time grammar checking, tone detection, and generative AI features.

Grammarly offers comprehensive writing assistance through desktop, mobile, and browser applications, serving individual users, students, and enterprise teams. The platform combines traditional grammar checking with advanced AI agents and generative writing tools to enhance communication across multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- AI Writing Assistant
- Grammar Checking
- Generative AI
- AI Agents
- Proofreading
- Tone Detection
- Multilingual Support
- Team Collaboration
- Enterprise Solution
- Browser Extension
- Grammarly Go
- Grammarly Docs
- Business Solution
- Writing Improvement

## Core Products & Features

- [Grammarly: Free AI Writing Assistance](https://www.grammarly.com): Grammarly homepage showcasing AI writing assistance across apps
- [Product Features | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/features): Grammarly product features including rewrites, tone, and style guides
- [Go | Your New Personal AI Assistant](https://www.grammarly.com/go-ai-assistant): Grammarly Go AI assistant with privacy controls across apps
- [Grammarly Docs | All-in-one AI Document Editor](https://www.grammarly.com/docs): Grammarly Docs AI editor for drafting and perfecting documents
- [AI Agents | Grammarly AI Agents Directory](https://www.grammarly.com/ai-agents): Directory of Grammarly AI Agents for writing enhancement
- [Artificial Intelligence (AI) at Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/ai): Grammarly AI capabilities for business communication and collaboration

## Platform & Access

- [Grammarly for Your Desktop | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/desktop): Grammarly desktop app for writing in apps and browsers
- [Grammarly for Mobile | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/mobile): Grammarly mobile app for iOS/Android messaging and email
- [Grammarly for your browser | Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/browser): Grammarly browser extension for writing across websites
- [Transform your writing in languages spanning Spanish to Italian](https://www.grammarly.com/languages): Grammarly multilingual support for Spanish, French, German, Portuguese
